Discover modern city living in 29 Boulevard Tower 2, one of the most sought-after residential addresses in Downtown Dubai. This well-designed apartment offers a comfortable layout with bright interiors and a welcoming atmosphere, ideal for both end-users and investors.

Residents can enjoy a premium lifestyle with easy access to world-class dining, shopping destinations, entertainment venues, and iconic landmarks nearby. The tower also provides excellent amenities and connectivity to major roads across Dubai.

A perfect opportunity to own a home in a vibrant and prestigious community.
